summary: Deployed a rootless Podman Quadlet-managed container (httpd:alpine) on node1 running as the unprivileged user appsvc, publishing port 8080. Enabled systemd user lingering for appsvc so its user manager (and the container unit) starts at boot without any active login session. Verified via a full node reboot that the boot identity changed and the service, listener, and HTTP endpoint all recovered automatically while appsvc had no login session (state: lingering only).
actions_performed: Created unprivileged user appsvc with auto-assigned subuid/subgid ranges
Enabled systemd lingering for appsvc (loginctl enable-linger)
Pulled docker.io/library/httpd:alpine as appsvc via rootless podman
Wrote a Podman Quadlet unit (~appsvc/.config/containers/systemd/webapp.container) publishing 8080:80, Restart=always, WantedBy=default.target
Reloaded and started the generated webapp.service under appsvc's systemd --user instance
Verified HTTP 200 on NODE_IP:8080 and confirmed no active login session for appsvc (only lingering state)
Captured pre-reboot boot_id baseline, issued systemctl reboot on node1, polled until exec access returned
Confirmed changed boot_id post-reboot, and verified webapp.service, port 8080 listener, and HTTP 200 all recovered automatically at boot with appsvc still having no login session

evidence.requirement: Containerized web app running as unprivileged appsvc on port 8080
evidence.summary: Rootless podman Quadlet service webapp.service active, running httpd container, listening on *:8080 via pasta, curl to NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200

evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session
evidence.summary: loginctl shows appsvc only in 'lingering' state with zero entries in list-sessions both before and after reboot, yet webapp.service and user@1000.service are active
Captured boot_id 4a743885-c59f-43ee-afde-ef96f7bea723 and confirmed HTTP 200 plus no login session before reboot
systemctl reboot issued and acknowledged (pre-reboot boot_id echoed) before the connection dropped as expected

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Post-reboot boot_id a0b068f5-beb9-44b7-8e92-653079089e9d differs from pre-reboot value, and uptime -s shows a fresh boot time
webapp.service and user@1000.service both active since the new boot time, port 8080 listening, curl to NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200, appsvc still has no login session
